name: ContactHero
description: Contact page hero with headline and supporting copy.
dense: Contact page hero: headline plus supporting copy, background and compact variants.

usage.description: ContactHero opens a contact page with a headline and supporting copy; compact tightens vertical rhythm for shorter pages. Copy arrives via props (title, subtitle), so route-level i18n stays in the page component. The current editorial contact layout owns its own heading, so check ContactPageContentEditorial before reaching for this.
